description: A small alert dialog over the main window asking for a session's (or a Bot's) new name.
opens: key F2 on a session row

parts.name: heading
parts.shows: "Rename session"; for a Bot on a host, "Rename Bot".

parts.name: name field
parts.shows: A single text field, pre-filled with the session's current title (a Bot's: its name), focused. Enter confirms.

actions.does: Edits the name. Spaces are tidied (runs collapsed, trimmed) and it's cut to 80 characters.

parts.name: Rename
parts.shows: "Rename" button, the default, in the suggested (accent) style.

actions.does: Renames, unless the name is blank or unchanged. Here: the title is written to the session (to the live one through the running claude), and a rename of the open chat updates its header title. On a host: the host renames it, and it's listed by the new title straight away; a host that refuses says "<host> didn't rename it: <why>" in a toast. A Bot's name is changed (its picture kept).
